description: Read the queries that actually triggered an ad, with the keyword each one matched and its metrics. This is the paid equivalent of the Search Console query dimension. Google withholds terms too few people searched, so an absent term is unknown rather than absent; read-only

days.description: How many days back to report, ending today

minCost.description: Drop search terms that cost less than this over the window

minImpressions.description: Drop search terms below this many impressions

zeroConversionsOnly.description: Keep only terms that converted nothing, which is the list that feeds negative keywords

name: ads_search_terms

matchType.description: How the term matched the keyword. A wrong term and a right term in the wrong ad group have different fixes
